title: PUT /books/{id} never persists isbn and echoes isbn:"" when omitted
evidence: handler.go:156 selects only title/author/year; handler.go:184 UPDATE omits isbn; handler.go:202 returns bookISBNOrDefault(req.ISBN, "") so a PUT with isbn reports a change that was not stored, and a PUT without isbn returns an empty isbn
suggestion: Read and update isbn alongside the other fields, and return the stored row

title: README says the server listens on 8080 but it defaults to 8000
evidence: README.md curl examples and 'starts on port 8080'; main.go:27 addr := ":8000"
suggestion: Make README and main.go agree on the default port

title: Non-numeric or missing id returns 404 instead of 400
evidence: handler.go:43-53 extractID returns (0, nil) on parse failure, so the 400 branch at handler.go:26 is unreachable
suggestion: Return an error from extractID on Atoi failure or missing segment
